quote: The TSA is an Ancillary Agreement under APA § 1.1(b), and APA § 10.12 provides that the APA controls in case of conflict. But if a dispute arises under the TSA ... a Delaware court applying Delaware law might interpret key terms differently than a New York court would.
reason: The memo correctly finds that TSA § 9.3 selects Delaware law and courts while the APA selects New York, flags the forum-fragmentation risk, and recommends conforming the TSA to New York law and New York County courts. It fails one required element. The memo says APA § 10.12 makes the APA control in a conflict. The key says § 10.12 lets each Ancillary Agreement control as to its own subject matter, so the TSA's Delaware clause is not overridden and the conflict is not cured. The memo misreads the precedence clause and never explains why it fails to cure the mismatch.
